# Meet Sophie

> Sophie is a premium AI voice thinking partner for professionals. She helps users think through decisions, prepare for meetings, practice sales pitches, and brainstorm ideas — through natural voice conversation with memory and continuity.

Meet Sophie is operated by M+M Hammer Ltd. (Cyprus). Sophie is not a chatbot — she is a voice-first AI companion designed for reflection, coaching, and structured thinking.

## Core Product Pages
- [Homepage](https://www.meet-sophie.com/): Overview of Sophie as an AI thinking partner — voice-first, with memory, continuity, and structured thinking modes
- [Login / Start](https://www.meet-sophie.com/login): Start a free first conversation with Sophie or access your account

## Thinking Modes
- Sophie offers multiple thinking modes: Brainstorming (solo and team idea exploration), Meeting Mode (preparation, live support, post-meeting summary), and Sales Pitch coaching (practice, feedback, scoring)
- All modes are voice-first with optional text messaging
- Sophie generates a Thinking Report after each session summarizing key insights

## Key Differentiators
- Voice-first design: talking is faster and more natural than typing
- Session memory: Sophie retains relevant context across conversations
- Not therapy: Sophie is explicitly designed for thinking and decision-making, not emotional support or crisis intervention
- Always clearly AI: Sophie never pretends to be human
- Multi-AI backend: Sophie uses multiple AI providers for reliability, quality, and cost optimization

## Use Cases
- Exploring and developing new ideas before committing
- Thinking through complex decisions with structured reflection
- Preparing for important meetings or difficult conversations
- Practicing and improving sales pitches with scored feedback
- Founder and leadership sparring — pressure-testing ideas privately
- Returning to ongoing thoughts with continuity across sessions

## Pricing
- Free: A first conversation to experience Sophie
- Sophie Plus: Ongoing access with longer conversations and continuity
